advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.r: Your Sanity: the world wears it down, and comfort brings it back. Learn what does which by meeting it.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.l: Low light wears your Sanity down.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.w: Water and rain wear your Sanity down.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.u: Some dimensions, like the Nether, wear your Sanity down.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.h: Hostile mobs nearby wear your Sanity down.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.c: A pet, a villager or another player nearby restores your Sanity.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.m: A jukebox playing nearby restores your Sanity.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.s: A disc you heard lately restores less each time it plays; two other discs in between freshen it.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.f: A Flower Crown restores your Sanity while you wear it, until it wilts.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.s: Out of the Corner of Your Eye
Your own Shadow Creatures nearby wear your Sanity down, and more once they turn real.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.u: Carrying Umbra wears your Sanity down, a little or a lot of it alike.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.f: Some foods restore your Sanity, and some wear it down.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.s: Sleeping through the night restores your Sanity.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.f: Picking a flower restores a little Sanity.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.s: Each hit from a real Shadow Creature tears away a piece of your Sanity.
Killing a real Shadow Creature steadies your mind, a Gaunt more than a Lurker.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.u: Your Sanity has slipped below Sane: you are Uneasy.
advancements.atouchofmadness.discovery.i: Your Sanity is nearly gone: you are Insane.
